_howto: To add an episode: copy one block in 'episodes', set 'ep' (number), 'id' (the YouTube video ID, the part after watch?v= in the URL), and 'title'. 'track' must match one of the ids in 'tracks' below - it decides which learning path the episode appears under. 'blurb' is a one-line summary shown on the card and in the guided path. 'story' is optional: write as much as you want and it appears under the player when that episode is opened. To start Season 2 someday, copy the whole season block. No HTML changes ever needed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.tagline: A 30-day season. Coffee, music, and real moments from the studio.
seasons.story: Thirty episodes, thirty days, one room. I made Brew in the Stu by showing up every single day for a month - filming, recording, editing, and posting the same day, entirely by myself. No crew, no scripts, no buffer of pre-made episodes to fall back on. Some days I had something worth saying. Some days I had to find it on camera. What came out is part studio diary, part everything I have learned about making music and why people get stuck making it. You do not have to watch it in order. Pick the path that sounds like where you are right now.
